criterion: Produce daily JSON/CSV/HTML reports from one versioned schema and keep totals equal across output formats and operating systems.
test_result: 44 daily-report and forward CLI tests passed; Ruff, targeted mypy, refreshed source inventory, and inventory check passed. All JSON/CSV/HTML totals parse to the same values; output bytes are deterministic with LF CSV newlines.
evidence_scope: Synthetic hash-verified EOD account archives and durable runner journals, including cash/position totals and CLI sibling-file generation.
operational_limits: Requires a valid account archive and hash-verified runner journal session plan.
Reports are paper evidence and do not claim exchange executions or profitability.
Files are atomically replaced individually; publication should verify the shared report hash and complete sibling set.
